Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) with mechanism action_type INHIBITOR. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno. Join target_dictionary on drug_mechanism.tid. Join compound_structures on molregno as INNER JOIN. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id (from target_dictionary.chembl_id), target_name (from target_dictionary.pref_name). Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
